tokens.name: USD Coin
tokens.kind: Circle-issued (native); upgradeable proxy, the issuer can pause and blacklist

behaviour.issuerPowers: Circle can pause every transfer, blacklist an address (a blacklisted pool can neither send nor receive USDC), mint and burn through its minters, and replace the implementation behind the proxy (recorded under `proxy`; the gate refuses when it changes). None of this changes the proxy's pinned code hash.

checked.how: the functions the implementation dispatches on (PUSH4 scan of the code behind the proxy's ZeppelinOS slot, read from the reviewed endpoints: paused, pause, isBlacklisted, blacklist, mint, burn; no fee function); on a loopback fork: transfer, approve and transferFrom return true, approve from 5 to 7 succeeds, transferFrom of 3 received as 3

confirmation.revertedWhy: The safe block's batch is on Ethereum: replacing it needs an Ethereum reorganisation, not a sequencer restart. Measured 2026-11-17: 65 to 69 s behind the head.
confirmation.residualRisk: settle: a sequencer reorganisation deeper than 50 blocks (about 10 s); as OP Mainnet. strict: the chain's finalized tag.

reserveCapsReason: No caps (coordinator's technical decision, 2026-11-17): an ordinary constant-product exchange. The caps exist on the Bloch L2 to bound what a fault of the bridge can drain through a pool of a bridged asset; the assets listed here are the chain's own native coin and a token issued on this chain, so that risk does not exist, and a pool capped on both sides would leak its fees to whoever calls skim first (docs/MULTICHAIN-DEPLOY.md section 2).

openingPrice.minimumReason: At least 0.1 ETH and its USDC at the market price: as OP Mainnet. Inflating the first share is not possible at any size (only the depositing account can mint first, and the pair locks 1,000 share units); the tool also refuses a deposit whose share supply would be under 10^12 units, so that the locked units are at most a billionth of it.
